name: Pre-INNOCENT INCEST
source:
Includes 2 stories that take place prior to the main story

First Kiss-saya side - Depicts Saya and Akito's first kiss

Endless Summer - Depicts Akito's POV for [url=https://vndb.org/v12759] End End Summer[/url]
translation:
收錄兩段發生在正篇之前的故事。

《初吻——沙耶篇》：講述沙耶與彰人的初吻。

《無盡之夏》：從彰人的視角重述[url=https://vndb.org/v12759]《End End Summer》[/url]的故事。
